title: Frontend dirty state tracking and explicit save button (F-001)
description: Implement dirty state tracking in FeaturesSettings.tsx using a Set<string> to track which fields the user actually modified. Replace the current save-on-every-toggle behavior with an explicit 'Save (N changes)' button. The save operation sends the full data object plus an optional dirtyKeys array to the backend. When dirtyKeys is absent, backend falls back to current full-sync behavior for backward compatibility.

criteria: FeaturesSettings.tsx contains 1 useRef<Set<string>> for dirtyFields tracking
1 handleChange function replaces direct handleFeatureToggle for all field changes, adding field to dirtyFields set
1 explicit Save button with count display: 'Save (N changes)' appears when dirtyFields.size > 0
Save button disappears (hidden) after successful save when dirtyFields is cleared
postMessage call in handleSave includes dirtyKeys: Array.from(dirtyFields.current)
UIRequest.FeaturesSaveSettings message format supports optional dirtyKeys field
Backward compatibility maintained: save without dirtyKeys still works identically
convergence.definition_of_done: Features tab shows explicit Save button with dirty count; save sends dirtyKeys array; backward compatible
